column3: #2649 closed: LocalStorage.CreateOrUpdateSecretACL now runs its upsert and a FOR SHARE re-read of the live secret node in one transaction and rolls back if the node is gone; DeleteSecret UPDATEs (locks) the secret row before its CWE-284 ACL cascade, so the cascade either sees the committed grant or the grant fails closed. #4533 closed (the second variant #2649 names): the IsProjectMember pre-read is not serial-equivalent against RemoveProjectMember, so the same transaction, after the upsert, takes FOR SHARE on the grantee's direct user_roles rows at the node's project (lockDirectProjectGrants) and re-asks the membership question (isProjectMemberOn), refusing with storage.ErrSecretACLGranteeNotMember; RemoveAllProjectRoleGrants DELETEs (locks) those rows before DeleteSecretACLsByUserAndProject, so the cascade either sees the committed grant or the grant fails closed. Not covered: a group-only member (RemoveProjectMember refuses them as not a member; a group-membership removal has no ACL cascade, a separate gap). Proven: TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_vs_DeleteSecret_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_DeleteSecretAfterUpsert_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestLocalACL_RefusesSoftDeletedSecret, TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_vs_RemoveProjectMember_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACL_RemoveProjectMemberAfterUpsert_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestLivenessRace_GrantSecretACL_vs_RemoveProjectMember_Postgres, TestGrantSecretACL_MembershipRemovedBeforeUpsert_RefusedWithoutARow, TestLocalACL_RefusesNonMemberGrantee.
